title: TreePO: Enhancing Policy Efficacy and Inference Efficiency with Tree Modeling
authors_zh: Yizhi LI、Qingshui Gu、Zhoufutu Wen、Ziniu Li、Ruibin Yuan、Tianshun Xing、Shuyue Guo、Tuney Zheng、Xin Zhou、Xingwei Qu、Wangchunshu Zhou、Zheng Zhang、Wei Shen、Wei Xue、Qian Liu、Chenghua Lin、Jian Yang、Ge Zhang、Wenhao Huang
paper_type_zh: 树结构在线RLVR与推理效率研究
best_for_zh: 研究推理rollout数据、共享前缀搜索、RLVR信用分配、测试时计算与可复现性审计的读者
one_line: TreePO replaces independent math rollouts with shared-prefix segment trees and trains on terminal answer rewards through hierarchical subgroup advantages, releasing code, prompts, and checkpoints but not complete paper-run trees.
TreePO以共享前缀分段树替代独立数学rollout，并用终局答案奖励构造层级子组优势；官方发布了代码、提示与检查点，但没有发布可重建论文训练过程的完整树记录。
why: It exposes how rollout topology, branch allocation, fallback, token budgets, and outcome-reward credit assignment jointly shape RLVR efficiency, while showing why prompt releases alone are insufficient for branch-level reproducibility.
inclusion_reason: TreePO makes online reasoning-rollout structure itself an optimization object: shared-prefix segment trees reduce redundant inference, and terminal outcome rewards are transformed into ancestor-subgroup advantages for RLVR. It is therefore a direct Track 5 construction recipe, while its missing branch-complete rollout release is an important audit boundary.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online RL for mathematical reasoning commonly draws several complete responses independently for each query. That organization is easy to implement, but every response recomputes the same prompt and often a long common reasoning prefix. As rollout counts and token budgets rise, redundant prefix work becomes a material part of the training and test-time inference cost.

Independent trajectories also hide useful structure from the optimizer. They provide a set of terminal responses and answer rewards, but do not directly encode which responses share an early decision, where they diverge, or how a reward difference should be attributed to a shared segment. Standard group-relative outcome objectives therefore compare whole responses while leaving the topology of their generation unused.

TreePO studies both problems together. It asks whether a query can be expanded as a tree of fixed-length response segments, with branches sharing prefix KV cache, and whether terminal correctness can be converted into advantages relative to ancestor-defined subgroups. The target is not merely more search: it is a rollout substrate whose computation and credit assignment both follow the same tree.

The data question is consequential for this atlas. A runtime tree can support efficient generation and policy updates without becoming a reusable release. Auditing TreePO therefore requires separating the operational tree used during online RL from the public Hugging Face prompt/reward tables and from the released checkpoints. The official release confirms the latter artifacts, but it does not provide the complete paper-run trees or all branch, pruning, fallback, and query-rejection records.

数学推理的在线RL通常会针对每个问题独立采样多条完整回答。这种组织方式易于实现，但每条回答都会重新计算同一提示，并且常常重复计算很长的共同推理前缀。随着rollout数量和token预算增大，重复的前缀计算会成为训练与测试时推理成本的重要组成部分。

独立轨迹还会向优化器隐藏有用结构。它们提供一组终局回答及答案奖励，却不会直接编码哪些回答共享早期决策、在何处发生分叉，以及奖励差异应如何归因于共同片段。标准的组相对结果目标因而只能比较完整回答，没有利用生成过程的拓扑。

TreePO将这两个问题合并研究：它考察能否把一个问题展开为由定长回答片段组成的树，让不同分支共享前缀KV cache；同时考察能否把终局正确性转换为相对于祖先所定义子组的优势。其目标不只是增加搜索，而是让计算方式与信用分配都遵循同一棵树的rollout基础设施。

对本图谱而言，关键的数据问题是：运行时树能够支持高效生成和策略更新，却未必形成可复用发布。审计TreePO时必须区分在线RL期间使用的操作性树、公开的Hugging Face提示/奖励表，以及发布的检查点。官方发布确认了后两类工件，但没有提供论文实验的完整树，也没有提供全部分支、剪枝、fallback和问题组拒绝记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TreePO replaces a batch of independently decoded responses with a query-rooted tree. The root is the mathematical query; each non-root node is a generated response segment; and root-to-leaf paths are terminal textual trajectories. Width controls the target number of completed trajectories, depth controls the maximum number of segment steps, and segment length controls the maximum tokens decoded at one step. Branches that share a prefix reuse its KV cache instead of recomputing it.

The tree is also the feedback object. Each terminal path receives a programmatic answer-level correctness reward against the ground truth. For a trajectory, every ancestor induces a subgroup consisting of descendant terminal paths that share that prefix. TreePO subtracts the reward mean of each such subgroup, averages the resulting subgroup-relative advantages across the trajectory's ancestors, and applies global variance normalization. This is trajectory-value supervision derived from outcome rewards; it is not a process verifier that certifies each reasoning segment.

Branching is budgeted rather than unlimited. The algorithm allocates branch capacity over active paths, transfers unused capacity, stops paths on answer formatting, EOS, repetition, depth, or response-length conditions, and invokes fallback only when no active path remains before the target width has been collected. Thus branch allocation, stopping, and fallback are part of the construction contract, not incidental implementation details.

The official artifacts expose three different data surfaces. The Hugging Face dataset publishes prompts, ground-truth reward fields, and metadata; its default viewer shows 3,120 evaluation rows. The runtime DataSampleTree and trainer-facing objects carry ancestry, tokens, log-probabilities, stop status, step lengths, and fallback counters. The optional persisted diagnostics flatten terminal input/output pairs and aggregate statistics, so they do not preserve enough lineage to reconstruct the complete tree or every discarded decision.

TreePO用以数学问题为根的树替代一批独立解码的回答。根节点是数学问题，每个非根节点是一个生成的回答片段，从根到叶的路径构成终局文本轨迹。宽度控制目标完成轨迹数，深度控制最大片段步数，片段长度控制单步最多解码token数。共享前缀的分支复用该前缀的KV cache，而不重新计算。

这棵树同时也是反馈对象。每条终局路径都根据ground truth获得程序化的答案级正确性奖励。对于一条轨迹，每个祖先节点都会定义一个子组，其中包含共享该前缀的后代终局路径。TreePO分别减去这些子组的平均奖励，再对一条轨迹各祖先对应的子组相对优势取平均，最后执行全局方差归一化。这是由结果奖励推导出的轨迹价值监督，并不是逐段认证推理正确性的过程验证器。

分支数量受预算约束，并非无限扩展。算法在活跃路径之间分配分支容量、转移未使用容量，根据答案格式、EOS、重复、深度或回答长度条件停止路径；只有在目标宽度尚未收集完且已无活跃路径时才启动fallback。因此，分支分配、停止与fallback属于构造协议，而不是无关紧要的实现细节。

官方工件呈现三种不同的数据表面。Hugging Face数据集发布提示、ground-truth奖励字段及元数据，其默认viewer显示3,120条评估记录。运行时DataSampleTree和面向训练器的对象携带祖先关系、token、log-probability、停止状态、各步长度和fallback计数。可选的持久化诊断只保存扁平化终局输入输出对与汇总统计，因此不足以重建完整树或每一次被丢弃的决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
The main online-RL prompt mixture is reported as approximately 8,000 MATH level-3-to-5 queries following SimpleRL plus 40,000 DeepScaler samples. The official Hugging Face repository contains SimpleRL-simplelr_qwen_level3to5.train.parquet, its test counterpart, DeepScaler.train.parquet, DeepScaler.aime.parquet, and five aligned evaluation Parquets. Because the dataset card has no usable YAML configuration, the default viewer presents only 3,120 evaluation records as one auto-derived train split: AIME 60, AMC 166, MATH 1,000, MINERVA 544, and OlympiadBench 1,350. These viewer rows should not be mistaken for the online rollout corpus.

For online generation, the current Qwen2.5-7B base policy receives a query root and decodes fixed-length segments through veRL with a vLLM backend. The tree maintains an active prompt queue, shared prefix tokens and KV cache, current depth, per-node branching budget, and completed paths. The in-memory DataSampleTree records identifiers and ancestry through tree_idx, input and full response token IDs, per-token and cumulative log-probabilities, finished_reason, status, and token counts per step. Trainer-facing tensors contain prompts, responses, input IDs, masks, and positions, while non-tensor fields retain tree_idx, finish step, and fallback counters for the collected terminal samples.

A segment stops when it emits EOS or reaches its segment-token limit. A path can terminate when it produces a legal boxed answer, reaches EOS, triggers repetition detection, reaches the maximum depth, or reaches the response-token limit. The released helper treats a 32-character substring repeated eight times as repetition. That threshold is an implementation detail verified in code; the paper itself describes repetitive-substring stopping without publishing those exact numbers.

Tree construction uses a per-node branching budget and a target width. The reported online settings explore depth-by-segment pairs 28x256, 14x512, and 7x1024, with maximum width 16 and binary branching at each depth. Initial divergence may be fixed or sampled from 2 through 8. The released principal recipe selects 14x512, width 16, fixed step divergence 2, initial divergence up to 8, and a 7,168-token response limit. Budget is redistributed among active paths. If active paths are exhausted before width trajectories are available, depth-first fallback chooses eligible stopped candidates; the paper requires a formatted answer or EOS, while the released code exposes several configurable fallback policies.

Each terminal trajectory receives a rule-based final-answer reward by comparing its boxed result with the released ground truth. There is no learned judge in the reported mathematics setup and no label that establishes the correctness of intermediate segments. Root query groups whose rewards are all correct or all wrong are dynamically rejected because they have no reward variance. The paper reports sampling up to three times the 512-query batch to retain 512 informative groups and uses 16 trajectories per query for online training and validation.

TreePO then divides each trajectory according to its shared-prefix ancestors. For every induced descendant subgroup, it computes reward minus subgroup mean; the trajectory's hierarchical advantage is the simple average over its ancestor-level subgroup advantages, followed by global variance normalization. Subgroup-size weighting and rejection of all-positive or all-negative subgroups are reported as ablations, not as the selected method. The policy objective is a DAPO-modified GRPO setup with token-mean loss, clip bounds 0.2 and 0.28, no KL reward or loss, learning rate 1e-6, 10 warmup steps, batch size 512, gradient clipping 1.0, FSDP, and up to 20 epochs in the released script.

The released script additionally sets temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and top-k -1. The paper's 16-rollout shared-prefix illustration uses temperature 0.8, so the values belong to different experimental contexts. More importantly, the paper says that training-batch formation permits at most two additional sampling batches, whereas the released script sets algorithm.filter_groups.max_num_gen_batches=10. The official sources do not reconcile this 2-versus-10 difference or bind each reported table to an immutable run manifest.

The main training setup reports 64 GPUs, but not the GPU model. Separate offline efficiency experiments use one H100 80GB at 60% utilization, 64 prompts, 64 rollouts per prompt, no tensor or data parallelism, and a 7,000-token per-trajectory budget with depth times segment length fixed at 7,000. Evaluation uses AIME 2024, AMC 2023, MATH500, MINERVA, and OlympiadBench, with 16 rollouts and majority-vote accuracy; the reported metric is estimated over 1,000 sampling repetitions.

Release and construction must remain distinct. The Apache-2.0 GitHub repository includes the veRL/vLLM implementation, launch recipe, scripts, tests, and version notes. The Hugging Face collection includes TreePO-Qwen2.5-7B, fixed-divergence and heuristic variants, and TreePO_data. The public dataset schema contains data_source, a two-message prompt, ability, reward_model.{ground_truth,style}, and extra_info.{index,split}. It contains no generated reasoning trace, tree edge, per-branch reward outcome, pruning decision, fallback lineage, or rejected-query record.

主要在线RL提示混合被报告为约8,000条遵循SimpleRL的MATH level-3-to-5问题，加上40,000条DeepScaler样本。官方Hugging Face仓库包含SimpleRL-simplelr_qwen_level3to5.train.parquet及其test文件、DeepScaler.train.parquet、DeepScaler.aime.parquet，以及五个对齐后的评估Parquet。由于dataset card没有可用的YAML配置，默认viewer只把3,120条评估记录显示为一个自动生成的train split：AIME 60条、AMC 166条、MATH 1,000条、MINERVA 544条、OlympiadBench 1,350条。不能把这些viewer记录误认为在线rollout语料。

在线生成时，当前Qwen2.5-7B base策略接收问题根节点，并通过采用vLLM后端的veRL解码定长片段。树维护活跃提示队列、共享前缀token与KV cache、当前深度、每节点分支预算和已完成路径。内存中的DataSampleTree通过tree_idx记录标识与祖先关系，并保存输入及完整回答token ID、逐token和累计log-probability、finished_reason、状态及每步token数量。面向训练器的tensor包含提示、回答、输入ID、mask和position；非tensor字段则为已收集终局样本保留tree_idx、完成步与fallback计数。

一个片段在生成EOS或达到片段token上限时停止。一条路径可因生成合法boxed答案、到达EOS、触发重复检测、达到最大深度或达到回答token上限而终止。发布的辅助函数将同一个32字符子串重复八次判定为重复。这一阈值来自已核验代码；论文本身只描述了重复子串停止，没有公布这些精确数字。

树构造同时受每节点分支预算和目标宽度控制。论文报告的在线设置包括深度与片段长度组合28x256、14x512和7x1024，最大宽度为16，每层使用二叉分支。初始分叉因子可以固定，也可以从2到8采样。发布的主要recipe选用14x512、宽度16、固定逐步分叉因子2、最高为8的初始分叉，以及7,168 token回答上限。预算会在活跃路径之间重新分配。如果在收集到目标宽度的轨迹之前活跃路径已耗尽，深度优先fallback会选择符合条件的已停止候选；论文要求候选具有格式化答案或以EOS结束，而发布代码还提供多种可配置fallback策略。

每条终局轨迹都通过把boxed结果与发布的ground truth比较，获得规则式最终答案奖励。所报告的数学设置没有使用学习型judge，也没有标签能够证明中间片段正确。奖励全对或全错的根问题组会因缺乏奖励方差而被动态拒绝。论文报告会对512问题训练batch最多进行三倍采样，以保留512个有信息量的组；在线训练和验证中每题使用16条轨迹。

随后，TreePO依据共享前缀祖先划分每条轨迹。对于每个由祖先诱导出的后代子组，它计算“奖励减子组平均奖励”；一条轨迹的层级优势是各祖先层级子组优势的简单平均，之后执行全局方差归一化。按子组大小加权，以及拒绝全正或全负子组，都只是ablation，并非最终采用的方法。策略目标使用经DAPO修改的GRPO设置，包括token-mean loss、0.2/0.28裁剪边界、不使用KL reward或loss、学习率1e-6、10步warmup、batch size 512、gradient clip 1.0、FSDP，以及发布脚本中的最多20个epoch。

发布脚本还设置temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0和top-k -1。论文的16-rollout共享前缀示例使用temperature 0.8，因此这些数值属于不同实验语境。更重要的是，论文称训练batch形成时至多允许额外两个采样batch，而发布脚本把algorithm.filter_groups.max_num_gen_batches设置为10。官方来源没有解释这一“2对10”差异，也没有用不可变run manifest把每张报告表格绑定到具体配置。

主要训练设置报告使用64张GPU，但没有说明GPU型号。独立的离线效率实验使用一张H100 80GB、60%显存利用率、64个提示、每提示64条rollout，不使用tensor或data parallel，并把单轨迹预算设为7,000 token，且深度乘片段长度固定为7,000。评估覆盖AIME 2024、AMC 2023、MATH500、MINERVA和OlympiadBench，使用16条rollout与majority-vote accuracy；论文报告的指标通过1,000次采样重复估计。

发布工件与构造过程必须保持区分。采用Apache-2.0的GitHub仓库包含veRL/vLLM实现、启动recipe、脚本、测试和版本说明。Hugging Face collection包含TreePO-Qwen2.5-7B、固定分叉与启发式变体，以及TreePO_data。公开数据集schema包含data_source、双消息prompt、ability、reward_model.{ground_truth,style}和extra_info.{index,split}。其中没有生成推理轨迹、树边、逐分支奖励结果、剪枝决策、fallback谱系或被拒绝问题组记录。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest direct evidence concerns sampling efficiency under specified budgets. In the paper's fixed-initial-divergence training-time comparison, sequential sampling takes 5.78 GPU-hours, while tree sampling takes 4.29, 4.82, and 5.09 GPU-hours at branching factors 2, 4, and 8, respectively. For the more-initial-divergence model, sequential sampling takes 6.40 GPU-hours and the corresponding tree settings take 3.65, 4.56, and 5.05 GPU-hours. These are reported reductions of 12% to 43%, not a guarantee that every tree configuration is both faster and more accurate.

The controlled offline study holds prompt count, rollout count, sampling parameters, and a 7,000-token trajectory budget fixed. Across Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the reported geometric-mean gains are 40% in trajectories per second and 30% in tokens per second. The abstract's "up to" summary uses 40% at the trajectory level and 35% at the token level. The geometric mean and maximum are different summaries and should not be merged.

The experiments also show a budget-dependent search trade-off. The tested divergence factors 2, 4, and 8 produce different compute-performance curves, and wider search becomes favorable only at larger budgets. Table 2 does not show a uniformly dominant accuracy result at every lower-cost configuration. This supports the narrower conclusion that shared-prefix tree sampling can move the efficiency frontier under the reported setup; it does not establish that increasing width or depth is always beneficial.

The policy results supply evidence that the tree-derived advantage can be used for online RLVR, but benchmark performance is not evidence that the released data are complete or high quality. Correct final answers can coexist with invalid intermediate reasoning, and the public Hugging Face records are prompt/ground-truth rows rather than the actual rollout trees that produced the updates. Similarly, the availability of checkpoints demonstrates a release surface, not a complete provenance chain.

Artifact inspection adds evidence beyond aggregate results. The official repository contains an Apache-2.0 implementation with TreePO recipe code, veRL/vLLM integration, runtime tree structures, launch settings, tests, and diagnostics. The official Hugging Face collection contains multiple checkpoints and TreePO_data; the dataset server confirms the prompt/reward schema and 3,120 viewer rows. At the same time, neither surface provides immutable paper-run parent-child edges, every branch reward, all stopped or discarded paths, rejected query groups, or trainer-batch hashes.

Reproducibility evidence remains partial. The code and data were inspected at explicit commits, and the repository documents relevant development versions, but there is no tagged release or complete run-to-checkpoint manifest. The disagreement between at most two extra sampling batches in the paper and a maximum of 10 in the script is a concrete unresolved configuration drift. No independent rerun variance is reported in the checked official artifacts.

最直接、最有力的证据来自给定预算下的采样效率。在论文采用固定初始分叉的训练时比较中，顺序采样需要5.78 GPU-hour；分叉因子为2、4、8的树采样分别需要4.29、4.82和5.09 GPU-hour。对于采用更多初始分叉的模型，顺序采样需要6.40 GPU-hour，对应树设置分别需要3.65、4.56和5.05 GPU-hour。论文报告的降幅为12%到43%，但这并不保证每个树配置都同时更快且更准确。

受控离线研究固定提示数量、rollout数量、采样参数和7,000 token单轨迹预算。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，论文报告的几何平均增益为每秒轨迹数提高40%、每秒token数提高30%。摘要中的“up to”表述则是轨迹级40%和token级35%。几何平均与最大值是不同统计摘要，不能合并成同一个结论。

实验还显示了依赖预算的搜索权衡。分叉因子2、4和8形成不同的计算—性能曲线，更宽搜索只有在较大预算下才占优。Table 2并未显示某个低成本配置在所有情况下都取得最佳准确率。因此，更稳妥的结论是：在所报告设置下，共享前缀树采样可以改善效率前沿；这些证据不能证明增加宽度或深度总是有利。

策略实验表明，树派生优势可用于在线RLVR，但benchmark表现不是公开数据完整或高质量的证据。正确终局答案可能与错误中间推理并存，公开Hugging Face记录是提示/ground-truth行，而不是实际产生更新的rollout树。同样，检查点可用只证明存在发布表面，并不等于具有完整来源链。

工件检查提供了超出汇总结果的证据。官方仓库采用Apache-2.0，包含TreePO recipe代码、veRL/vLLM集成、运行时树结构、启动设置、测试和诊断。官方Hugging Face collection包含多个检查点和TreePO_data；dataset server确认了提示/奖励schema及3,120条viewer记录。与此同时，这两个表面都没有提供不可变的论文实验父子边、每个分支的奖励、全部停止或丢弃路径、被拒绝问题组，以及训练器batch hash。

可复现性证据仍然不完整。代码与数据在明确commit上完成核验，仓库也记录了相关开发版本，但没有tagged release或完整的run-to-checkpoint manifest。论文中的“至多额外两个采样batch”与脚本中的最大10个之间存在具体且未解决的配置漂移。已检查的官方工件也没有报告独立重跑方差。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
TreePO's distinguishing move is to make one shared-prefix tree serve two roles at once. It is an inference structure that avoids repeated prefix computation, and it is an optimization structure that defines hierarchical comparison groups for outcome-reward credit assignment. The contribution is therefore the coupling between rollout topology, compute reuse, and policy advantage—not tree-shaped generation by itself.

Compared with independent group sampling, the method preserves the shared decisions that relate terminal trajectories. Compared with a tree used only for test-time search, it feeds ancestry into online policy optimization. Compared with step-supervision methods, it does not require an external label for each reasoning step; it derives segment-sensitive trajectory advantages from terminal correctness and the descendant sets induced by shared prefixes.

The branching and fallback contract is also part of the contribution. Fixed segment lengths make shared computation explicit; width and depth give separate control over the number and shape of trajectories; budget transfer and fallback try to fill the terminal batch when branches finish early. These choices expose a concrete data-construction substrate whose behavior can be inspected in the official code.

The novelty claim should remain bounded. TreePO does not establish a general-purpose process verifier, and it does not release a new branch-complete trace dataset. Its public data contribution is a prompt/reward repository aligned with the method and evaluation, while the richer tree data object exists mainly at runtime. The work is most distinctive as a construction and optimization recipe whose complete lineage would need additional release engineering.

TreePO最具区别性的设计，是让同一棵共享前缀树同时承担两种角色：它既是避免重复前缀计算的推理结构，也是定义层级比较组、用于结果奖励信用分配的优化结构。因此，其贡献在于rollout拓扑、计算复用与策略优势之间的耦合，而不只是采用树形生成。

相对于独立的组采样，该方法保留了终局轨迹之间共享的决策。相对于只用于测试时搜索的树，它把祖先关系送入在线策略优化。相对于步骤监督方法，它不需要对每个推理步骤提供外部标签，而是利用终局正确性和共享前缀诱导出的后代集合，推导出对片段结构敏感的轨迹优势。

分支与fallback协议也是该贡献的一部分。固定片段长度显式化了共享计算；宽度与深度分别控制轨迹数量和形状；预算转移与fallback则在分支提前停止时尝试填满终局batch。这些选择给出了一个具体的数据构造基础设施，其行为可在官方代码中检查。

对新颖性的表述必须保持边界。TreePO没有建立通用过程验证器，也没有发布新的分支完整轨迹数据集。其公开数据贡献是与方法和评估对齐的提示/奖励仓库，而更丰富的树数据对象主要存在于运行时。它最独特的定位是构造与优化recipe；若要获得完整谱系，仍需要额外的发布工程。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Outcome verification is narrow. A boxed-answer equivalence rule scores the final result, not the validity of each intermediate segment. A trajectory may receive positive reward despite flawed reasoning, and the parser or equivalence rule may mishandle alternative but mathematically equivalent forms. Tree-relative baselines redistribute these outcome rewards; they do not repair the underlying verifier.

Retention is incomplete. Repetition-stopped, max-depth, max-length, answer-complete, and EOS paths may enter the terminal sample pool, but short-filtered paths and unallocated active branches can disappear. Root groups with all-correct or all-wrong rewards are dynamically removed, and no rejected-query manifest is published. Consequently, the public release cannot answer which branches were considered, pruned, starved of budget, used for fallback, or excluded from updates.

The persisted diagnostic format is not a full tree log. It contains arguments, timing and length summaries, aggregate depth/token distributions, and flattened input/output pairs. It omits stable parent-child edges, per-record finish reasons, branch allocation decisions, fallback ancestry, branch-level rewards, group-rejection decisions, and exact trainer batches. Even when a terminal response is retained, its full construction lineage is not guaranteed to be recoverable.

The public Hugging Face release is easy to misread. Its default viewer exposes 3,120 benchmark-aligned records in an automatically named train split, even though repository filenames distinguish training and evaluation Parquets. The dataset card lacks the metadata needed to declare semantic configurations and splits. It also publishes no dataset license. The code's Apache-2.0 license applies to the implementation, not automatically to the data or model weights; the model-weight license is also unknown.

Data governance remains undisclosed. There is no reported prompt-level decontamination or semantic-overlap audit across the SimpleRL/DeepScaler mixture, evaluation benchmarks, or base-model pretraining data. Upstream row-level source and rights manifests are absent. Random seeds, the hardware model for the 64-GPU online runs, failure runs, complete logs, container hashes, and independent rerun variance are unknown.

Configuration drift weakens exact reproduction. The paper permits at most two additional sampling batches during informative-group formation, while the released training script permits up to 10. Temperatures reported for the main script and a paper case study also refer to different contexts. Without an immutable manifest for each result, readers cannot determine which exact code and sampling limits produced every reported checkpoint or table.

The efficiency findings are conditional. Gains depend on how much prefix sharing the policy produces, segment length, branching factor, target width, stop behavior, vLLM scheduling, and hardware. Wider or deeper trees are not uniformly better, and reduced GPU-hours do not uniformly preserve the highest reported accuracy. The H100 offline setup and the undisclosed 64-GPU hardware should not be generalized into a universal cost claim.

Finally, the accepted ICML 2026 OpenReview record differs from the earlier arXiv/project/repository citation in title, year, and author list. The venue record adds authors and uses the accepted title. Automated citation harvesting can therefore regress the Card to the older 2025 metadata unless the accepted record remains canonical.

结果验证的覆盖面有限。boxed答案等价规则只评价最终结果，不验证每个中间片段的有效性。轨迹可能在推理错误的情况下仍获得正奖励，解析器或等价规则也可能误判不同形式但数学等价的答案。树相对baseline只会重新分配这些结果奖励，并不能修复底层验证器。

保留策略并不完整。因重复、最大深度、最大长度、答案完成或EOS而停止的路径可能进入终局样本池，但被短长度过滤的路径和未获分配的活跃分支可能直接消失。奖励全对或全错的根问题组会被动态移除，且没有发布被拒绝问题清单。因此，公开工件无法回答哪些分支曾被考虑、剪枝、因预算不足而丢弃、用于fallback，或被排除在更新之外。

持久化诊断格式不是完整树日志。它包含参数、时间与长度汇总、聚合深度/token分布及扁平化输入输出对，却省略稳定父子边、逐记录停止原因、分支分配决策、fallback祖先关系、逐分支奖励、问题组拒绝决策和精确训练器batch。即使某条终局回答被保留，也不保证能够恢复其完整构造谱系。

公开Hugging Face发布很容易被误读。虽然仓库文件名区分训练与评估Parquet，默认viewer却把3,120条benchmark对齐记录显示在一个自动命名的train split中。dataset card缺少声明语义配置和split所需的元数据，也没有公布dataset license。代码的Apache-2.0只适用于实现，不能自动扩展到数据或模型权重；模型权重许可证同样为unknown。

数据治理信息仍未披露。论文没有报告SimpleRL/DeepScaler混合、评估benchmark与base model预训练数据之间的提示级去污染或语义重叠审计，也缺少逐行上游来源与权利清单。随机种子、64-GPU在线实验的GPU型号、失败运行、完整日志、容器hash和独立重跑方差均为unknown。

配置漂移削弱了精确复现。论文在有信息量问题组形成过程中至多允许额外两个采样batch，而发布训练脚本允许最多10个。主要脚本与论文case study报告的temperature也属于不同语境。由于每项结果没有不可变manifest，读者无法确定每个报告检查点或表格究竟由哪一份精确代码和采样限制产生。

效率结论具有条件性。增益取决于策略产生的前缀共享程度、片段长度、分叉因子、目标宽度、停止行为、vLLM调度和硬件。更宽或更深的树并非总是更好，GPU-hour降低也不总能保持最高报告准确率。单H100离线设置与未披露型号的64-GPU训练不能被泛化为普遍成本结论。

最后，ICML 2026已接收OpenReview记录与更早的arXiv/project/repository引用在标题、年份和作者列表上不同。venue记录增加了作者，并使用接收版标题。若不持续以接收记录为canonical，自动引用收集可能让Card退回旧的2025元数据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track, TreePO is a concrete example of why the rollout data object is more than final text. The useful unit includes the prompt root, segment boundaries, shared-prefix ancestry, branch allocation, stopping reason, fallback choice, terminal answer reward, and the subgroup context used to compute advantage. Removing those fields turns a tree-conditioned policy update into an unauditable bag of responses.

For RLVR researchers, the method provides a reproducible conceptual recipe for converting answer-level rewards into hierarchical trajectory advantages without introducing a learned process reward model. It is useful for comparing root-level group baselines with subtree-relative baselines, studying how group rejection alters the online curriculum, and testing whether credit assignment gains persist when the outcome verifier is imperfect.

For systems researchers, the implementation exposes the relationship among segment size, branch width, shared-prefix KV-cache reuse, active-path scheduling, and fallback. The reported online and offline budgets offer concrete starting points for controlled studies. Any reuse should record both tokens and tree structure, because the same terminal-trajectory count can arise from materially different depth, divergence, and prefix-sharing patterns.

For test-time-compute research, TreePO shows that branching factor and tree shape produce budget-dependent performance curves rather than a monotonic "more search is better" rule. The released code and checkpoints can support follow-up evaluations of adaptive width, depth, or segment policies, provided new work distinguishes inference-only tree search from the online RL procedure that created the policy.

For data release design, the work is a useful negative specification. A branch-auditable package would preserve immutable prompt IDs, source and split provenance, complete parent-child edges, tokens and log-probabilities, allocation probabilities, every stop and prune reason, fallback lineage, terminal rewards, rejected root groups, subgroup memberships, computed advantages, trainer-batch IDs, seeds, code/config hashes, and checkpoint bindings. This would make both successful and failed search behavior reusable.

For auditors, the official prompt tables, Apache-licensed code, and checkpoints enable artifact-level inspection, but not record-level reproduction of the paper's online data flow. The appropriate use is therefore method analysis and partial reproduction—not treating TreePO_data as a released corpus of TreePO rollout trees, and not using benchmark accuracy as a proxy for trace validity or release completeness.

对于Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data方向，TreePO具体说明了为什么rollout数据对象不只是最终文本。真正有用的单元还包括提示根节点、片段边界、共享前缀祖先关系、分支分配、停止原因、fallback选择、终局答案奖励，以及计算优势时所用的子组上下文。去掉这些字段，会把树条件策略更新退化为不可审计的回答集合。

对于RLVR研究者，该方法提供了一种概念上可复现的recipe：无需引入学习型过程奖励模型，就能把答案级奖励转换为层级轨迹优势。它适合比较根级组baseline与子树相对baseline，研究问题组拒绝如何改变在线课程，并检验当结果验证器不完美时，信用分配增益能否保持。

对于系统研究者，官方实现暴露了片段大小、分支宽度、共享前缀KV-cache复用、活跃路径调度与fallback之间的关系。论文报告的在线与离线预算可以作为受控研究的具体起点。任何复用都应同时记录token和树结构，因为相同的终局轨迹数量可能来自完全不同的深度、分叉和前缀共享模式。

对于测试时计算研究，TreePO表明分叉因子与树形会形成依赖预算的性能曲线，而不是“搜索越多越好”的单调规律。发布代码与检查点可支持自适应宽度、深度或片段策略的后续评估，但新研究需要区分纯推理时树搜索，与创建该策略的在线RL过程。

对于数据发布设计，这项工作还是一份有用的反向规格。可进行分支审计的发布包应保存不可变提示ID、来源与split谱系、完整父子边、token与log-probability、分配概率、每个停止和剪枝原因、fallback谱系、终局奖励、被拒绝根问题组、子组成员关系、计算出的优势、训练器batch ID、随机种子、代码/配置hash及检查点绑定。这样才能同时复用成功与失败的搜索行为。

对于审计者，官方提示表、Apache许可代码与检查点支持工件级检查，却不足以逐记录复现论文的在线数据流。因此，合适用途是方法分析与部分复现；不应把TreePO_data当作已发布的TreePO rollout树语料，也不应把benchmark准确率当作轨迹有效性或发布完整性的替代指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the three surfaces separate: public prompt/reward Parquets, runtime tree objects, and released model checkpoints.
  • Interpret the 3,120-row Hugging Face viewer split as benchmark-aligned prompt records, not a corpus of online rollout trees.
  • Read the hierarchical advantage as outcome-reward redistribution over shared-prefix subgroups, not as step correctness supervision.
  • Compare every efficiency number with its exact width, depth, segment length, rollout count, hardware, and statistic; averages and maxima are not interchangeable.
  • Treat the paper's two extra sampling batches and the script's maximum of 10 as unresolved configuration drift.
  • Before reuse, resolve dataset and model licenses, decontamination, seeds, and the missing complete branch/prune/fallback/rejection lineage.

• 严格区分三种表面：公开提示/奖励Parquet、运行时树对象，以及发布的模型检查点。
  • 将Hugging Face viewer中的3,120行理解为benchmark对齐提示记录，而不是在线rollout树语料。
  • 将层级优势理解为在共享前缀子组上重新分配结果奖励，而不是步骤正确性监督。
  • 阅读任何效率数字时，都要核对其宽度、深度、片段长度、rollout数量、硬件和统计口径；平均值与最大值不可互换。
  • 将论文的额外两个采样batch与脚本最大10个视为尚未解决的配置漂移。
  • 复用前应解决dataset和model license、去污染、随机种子，以及缺失的完整分支/剪枝/fallback/拒绝谱系。

value.html: Online query-rooted trees of shared-prefix reasoning segments whose terminal textual trajectories are paired with programmatic answer outcomes and tree-relative subgroup advantages; the complete paper-run tree records are not publicly released.

Approximately 8,000 MATH level-3-to-5 questions following SimpleRL plus 40,000 DeepScaler training questions. The official HF repository releases corresponding train/test Parquets and aligned evaluation Parquets, but its default viewer exposes only 3,120 evaluation rows as one auto-derived train split.
The rollout engine observes decoded segments, answer formatting, EOS, repeated substrings, token log-probabilities, depth, response length, active-path counts, and completed-path counts.
Free-form mathematical chain-of-thought text with a final answer expected in legal boxed{} formatting; EOS, repetition, depth, and output-token limits can also terminate a path.
The current Qwen2.5-7B base policy during online RL training. Separate offline efficiency analyses use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-Math-7B.
Online segment-level tree generation implemented in veRL with a vLLM backend; common prefixes share KV-cache computation while active branches are scheduled through a prompt queue.
Programmatic boxed-answer equivalence and DAPO-style group filtering; no learned judge or reward model is required by the reported math setup.
Rule-style final-answer equivalence against the ground truth plus a terminal correctness reward. There is no independently supervised process-correctness label for each segment.

Outcome reward R_i is final-answer correctness. TreePO forms ancestor-defined trajectory subgroups, subtracts each subgroup mean reward, averages the subgroup-relative advantages across ancestors, and applies global variance normalization.

A legal boxed answer, EOS, maximum response length, maximum tree depth, or repetition stop ends a path. Paper fallback selects only stopped paths with formatted answers or EOS; implementation behavior is policy-configurable.

Official code, prompt/reward Parquets, and model checkpoints are released. No immutable corpus of paper-run rollout trees, all branches, pruned paths, group-rejected queries, rewards, or trainer batches was found.

Released SimpleRL/DeepScaler prompt and ground-truth Parquets -> current-policy segment rollouts -> shared-prefix tree with branching, pruning, and fallback -> terminal rule reward -> hierarchical subgroup advantages -> TreePO policy updates -> released checkpoints and benchmark evaluation.

The in-memory DataSampleTree contains ancestry, response tokens, log-probabilities, status, finish reason, and per-step token counts. Trainer-facing DataProto returns terminal responses plus tree_idx, finish step, and fallback counters.

The optional diagnostic JSON stores arguments, timing/length summaries, aggregate depth and token-count distributions, and flattened input/output pairs. It does not preserve full tree edges, per-record finish reason, all active/pruned branches, rejected query groups, or fallback lineage.
Qwen2.5-7B base for the main RL training. Offline efficiency experiments additionally use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-Math-7B.
unknown
The current policy decodes fixed-length segments, forks selected prompt prefixes, and reuses shared-prefix KV cache through the vLLM inference backend.
MATH level-3-to-5 questions following SimpleRL and the DeepScaler collection; evaluation uses AIME 2024, AMC 2023, MATH500, MINERVA, and OlympiadBench.

Binary per-depth branching with maximum width 16; the reported online settings explore depth-by-segment pairs 28x256, 14x512, and 7x1024. Initial divergence is fixed or randomly assigned from 2 to 8. Branching budget is redistributed over active paths, and depth-first fallback runs only when no active path remains and the target width has not been reached.
16 trajectories per query for online training and validation. The data loader samples three times the 512-query training batch and retains 512 non-zero-reward-variance groups.
Released training script sets temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and top-k -1. The paper's 16-rollout shared-prefix case study uses temperature 0.8.
Segment-level shared-prefix search, branching-budget transfer, answer/EOS/repetition stopping, depth-first fallback, and ancestor-defined trajectory subgroups.

Root query groups must have non-zero reward standard deviation. All active branches receive at least one branch in the probability-based allocation ablations, but not every possible or pruned branch is retained.

Prompts longer than 1,024 tokens are filtered. Root query groups with all-correct or all-wrong terminal rewards are dynamically rejected. Repetition can stop a branch; subgroup-level all-positive/all-negative rejection was tested and not adopted.

Static programmatic outcome correctness followed by subgroup-relative baselines, simple averaging across ancestors, and global variance normalization. Subgroup-size weighting and subgroup rejection are ablations, not the selected method.
unknown

Online training uses a 7,168-token response limit and the released main script selects 14x512, width 16, fixed step divergence 2, and initial divergence up to 8. Table 2 compares sequential sampling with 8x2048 trees at branching factors 2, 4, and 8. Offline efficiency uses 64 prompts and 64 rollouts per prompt on one H100 80GB at 60% utilization with a 7,000-token per-trajectory budget and no tensor/data parallelism.

DAPO-modified GRPO with TreePO hierarchical advantages, clip-low 0.2, clip-high 0.28, token-mean loss, no KL reward/loss, learning rate 1e-6, 10 warmup steps, batch size 512, gradient clip 1.0, FSDP, and at most 20 epochs in the released script.
The paper reports 64 GPUs for the main training setup and checkpoint interval 50. Hardware model for that 64-GPU run is not disclosed.

Table 2 reports 12%-43% lower GPU hours across tested tree settings. The controlled offline analysis reports a geometric-mean gain of 40% trajectories/s and 30% tokens/s across three Qwen2.5 variants; the abstract reports maxima of 40% trajectory-level and 35% token-level sampling reduction.

Main RL prompts are approximately 8K SimpleRL MATH level-3-to-5 plus 40K DeepScaler samples. The HF repository also packages AIME, AMC, MATH, MINERVA, and OlympiadBench evaluation Parquets. No row-level source/license/decontamination manifest links each training prompt to a paper-run rollout tree.

Root HF filenames distinguish DeepScaler train/AIME and SimpleRL train/test files, while an evaluation folder packages five aligned benchmark Parquets. Because the dataset card lacks YAML metadata, the default viewer exposes only 3,120 evaluation examples as one train split; semantic split bindings and exact paper-run hashes are not published.
No prompt-level or semantic overlap audit between the released training mixture, evaluation benchmarks, or base-model pretraining data was found.
